summary: Iteration 21 backend testing: verified NAME rule (client_first_name from intake grantor) and IRON GATE CONSULTING rule (no outside legal counsel suggestions) both at unit + end-to-end levels. All new unit tests, full regression suite, and live regenerate against seeded Michael Thompson case pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5216 lines — well over the 700-line guideline; should be split into feature modules (trust cases, admin, auth, page-explanation jobs) for maintainability.
_ATTORNEY_SENTENCE_PATTERNS regex in trust_page_explainer.py is dense and hard to maintain; consider decomposing into named sub-patterns with comments/tests per branch.
Existing test files hard-fail at import when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is unset (os.environ['..']); a graceful pytest.skip would be friendlier for local dev.
seed_data_creation: None — reused existing seeded Michael Thompson case 8eb42bd3-5d43-43f2-b765-b98a144bd931.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 21 confirmed. New unit tests in test_page_explainer_scrubs.py cover _scrub_attorney_advice (7 sentence variants incl. HTML tag preservation + single-line dedup on multi-match) and _build_case_context.client_first_name derivation (grantor wins, fallback to client_name first token, whitespace-only grantor first name falls back). test_iteration21_e2e.py hits POST /api/admin/trust-cases/{id}/trust-page-explanations/regenerate then polls to completion and asserts every page mentions 'Michael', 0 attorney phrases, 0 banned jargon, and >=1 page contains the exact IRON_GATE_ADVISOR_LINE. Regression suite (test_page_explanations 7, test_page_resume 3, test_trust_draft_personalization 8) all pass — prompt rewrite did not break prior behavior. All test runs need REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported from the shell.
